lead: Use to pin down a vague request by interview, and to take a project from spec to published plan to test-first build: write or change the spec, break it into issues, build the next one, audit a sprint.

grill.cue: a vague or ambiguous ask: one question at a time

spec-init.cue: scaffold .agents/plan/ where no spec exists yet

spec-write.cue: author the spec from a brief or a codebase

spec-grill.cue: interrogate the spec for gaps and contradictions

spec-edit.cue: change a spec page, keep plan and tracker level

spec-open.cue: serve the spec site to read and comment on

plan-decompose.cue: the spec into epics, sprints, and issues

plan-publish.cue: a sprint of the plan tree into GitHub or GitLab issues

build-next-issue.cue: what is next: the unblocked issue, or a dispatch plan

build-tdd.cue: one plan issue: criteria to failing tests to done

build-sprint.cue: a sprint's issues in parallel, by subagents

build-audit.cue: a finished plan tree: what the plan missed

build-assess-drift.cue: where spec, plan, and code disagree

build-improve-architecture.cue: deepening refactors in built code, fed back to ADRs

build-rubber-duck.cue: talk a stuck problem through, changing no file

build-user-docs.cue: end-user docs from the spec and what shipped

autopilot.cue: every phase in order, spec to docs, one human gate
